cli.description: one process per conversion: `dimvexa convert VALUE FROM TO` (spawn + parse + print); one-shot only

prepared.description: Registry::conversion once, then Conversion::apply / apply_slice (f64 fast path, 1 ulp linear, 2 ulp affine); one-shot = conversion(from,to).apply(x) from strings

runtime.name: rustc
runtime.profile: release (thin LTO, codegen-units 1, default target CPU)
